sourceTitle: Memoirs, Correspondence and Manuscripts of General Lafayette
description: "Memoirs, Correspondence and Manuscripts of General Lafayette" by Lafayette is a historical account likely written in the early 19th century. This comprehensive collection offers insights into the life and experiences of General Marquis de Lafayette, highlighting his involvement in the American Revolution and his correspondence with prominent figures of the time, including George Washington.
